items.item_text: Must possess an M.D., D.O. or equivalent degree.
Residency training from an accredited residency training program.
Prior experience providing inpatient and/or outpatient pediatric care, newborn exams, and consults.

Pediatricians provide comprehensive patient care in the outpatient setting for infants, children, and adolescents. Patient care activities will include, but are not limited to: (1) Assessment, evaluation, diagnostic determination, on-going treatment and clinical management, necessary referral to pediatric subspecialists, care planning and modification, medications/therapeutic orders, routine wellness exams, immunizations, and developmental risk assessment. (2) Extensive and on-going communications with pediatric subspecialists, schools, and community resources involved in the holistic care of the pediatric patient. (3) Day-to-day patient contact and care management that actively encourages and includes professional input from families, caregivers, and all members of the multidisciplinary patient care team. (4) Accurate and timely completion of all clinical and professional records and documentation to assure compliance with local, state and federal regulatory, licensure and accreditation requirements. (5) May instruct residents, interns, and medical students in pediatric primary care and related services. (6) Participate in the after hours and weekend call schedule on a rotation basis. (80% time)

Communication: Direct contact and consultation with patient family members, advocates, and others to ensure effective communication of patient status and care plans, and to encourage/support an open visitor-friendly environment within the medical/hospital environment. (20% time)
Possession of the legal requirements for the practice of medicine in California as determined by the California Medical Board.
Must qualify for medical staff privileges at UCR Health and affiliated hospitals.
Must be eligible to practice in the State of California by the time of employment.
Ability to work effectively with staff and patients from diverse ethnic/racial backgrounds, educational levels, sexual orientations and identities.
Ability to stay abreast of new medical knowledge, and to maintain and increase expertise and skills as relevant to clinical practice.
Ability to work independently under general direction and to work collaboratively with others.
Strong background and skills in clinical practice, clinical teaching, and managed care.
